fieldContext.note: QoS constraints specify performance targets without mandating technology names (e.g., 'API response latency < 50ms at 99.9th percentile' is QoS; 'Use Redis cache' is a Technology Constraint).

personalNotes: Section 3.2 in SWEBOK connects QoS to economic curves (Value vs Cost to deliver, Fail point vs Perfection point). Modifiability vs speed trade-offs are classic QoS tensions.
